proposition.claim:
Recorded check: Theorem5.3 loses derivative bandwidth variance

n=m=T=alpha=1. a=1,b=0; zero supported coefficient perturbation. p0 standard Gaussian, all relevant mixed norms finite. M=2,N=1,delta=1/4; R tends to infinity. Samples follow actual product law.

Recorded check: Theorem8.11 claims mixed regularity beyond available parabolic orders

n=m=T=alpha=1,a=1,b=0. p0=(1+|x|)exp(-|x|)/4 nonnegative unit mass. p0 Fourier transform (1+k^2)^-2, so H3 but not stronger required mixed trace regularity.

Recorded check: Theorem5.8 sets empirical initial discrepancy to zero

repair.content:
Derivative variance and time interpolation must be reanalysed with a new parameter schedule; no replacement optimal rate asserted.

For constant heat flow, p0 in H7 suffices for H2_t H4_x by Fourier integration. No general variable-coefficient or full learning-rate repair claimed.

Use q=p_learned-p with zero initial value; forcing Lhat*(p-phat)+(Lhat*phat-dt phat)+(dt phat-dt p). If L(phat)<=eta^2, fitted residual<=B eta and Lhat*:H2->L2 norm<=B, forcing<= (2B+1)eta; energy gives density error<=CB eta. Does not repair P1/P2.
